person_relationships.description: Trần Thanh Mẫn is the Chairman of the National Assembly under whom Lê Quang Mạnh serves as Secretary General
Nguyễn Chí Dũng was the Minister of Planning and Investment when Lê Quang Mạnh served as Vice Minister (2018-2019)
Võ Thành Thống was swapped with Lê Quang Mạnh in 2019 - Thống became Vice Minister of Planning and Investment while Mạnh became Chairman of Can Tho City People's Committee

political_stances.stance_content: His doctoral thesis and career at the Ministry of Planning and Investment focused on economic development, business environment reform, and investment management, including overseeing the national business registration system.
Appointed as Deputy Head of the Standing Committee of the National Assembly's Digital Transformation Steering Committee (February 2026), indicating strong support for government digitization.
Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam for two consecutive tenures (13th and 14th), with advanced political theory training (Cao cấp). Joined the Party in October 2001.

major_achievements.achievement: Served as Director of the Business Registration Management Bureau (Cục trưởng Cục Quản lý đăng ký kinh doanh) from 2011 to 2014, overseeing Vietnam's national business registration reform and simplification
Elected Chairman of Can Tho City People's Committee with 94.4% approval rate, later becoming City Party Secretary in September 2020
Elected as Member of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Vietnam at the 13th National Party Congress, and re-elected at the 14th Congress in January 2026
Elected as Member of the Standing Committee of the National Assembly and Chair of the Committee on Finance and Budget, overseeing national fiscal legislation
Elected as Secretary General of the National Assembly and Chair of the Office of the National Assembly, one of the most senior administrative positions in the legislative branch

biography_summary: 黎光孟，1974年4月14日出生于越南河内市美德县（今美德社），京族，无宗教信仰。经济学博士学历，同时拥有发展经济学硕士、金融银行学硕士学位及企业管理（旅游管理方向）学士和英语学士学位，高级政治理论水平。2001年10月17日加入越南共产党。黎光孟1997年进入计划投资部工作，历经21年从合同制干部升至副部长（2018年），期间担任过企业登记管理局长、对外经济事务司长、地方经济与领土事务司长等要职，主导了越南企业登记制度改革。2019年5月被调任芹苴市，先后担任市委副书记兼人民委员会主席（市长，2019-2020）和市委书记（2020-2023）。2021年1月当选越共十三届中央委员，2026年1月十四大连任。2023年5月当选国会常务委员会委员兼财政预算委员会主任委员。2025年10月25日当选国会秘书长兼国会办公厅主任，成为越南立法机构最高行政负责人之一。2026年4月在第十六届国会第一次会议上连任该职务。

collection_meta.notes: Le Quang Manh is the incumbent Secretary General of the National Assembly and Chair of the NA Office. Born April 14, 1974 in Hanoi. PhD in Economics with multiple master's degrees. Career spans Ministry of Planning and Investment (1997-2019), Can Tho City leadership (2019-2023), and National Assembly (2023-present). CPV Central Committee member (13th, 14th tenures). Wikidata Q65171363 confirmed. Detailed career timeline available from daihoidang.vn and Wikipedia.
